expandedContent.content:
Cordyceps does its thing through four key compounds.

Cordycepin boosts ATP and mimics adenosine, so you get real energy and better endurance.
Polysaccharides support your immune system and overall vitality.
Adenosine helps your body manage energy and improves oxygen flow.
And sterols and peptides calm inflammation and build stress resilience.

Put it all together, and you've got a natural way to fuel your cells, breathe easier, and bounce back stronger.
